title: College football this Saturday: Ohio State-Iowa, Washington-USC
dek: Saturday's college football slate has Ohio State at Iowa, Washington at USC and Miami at Clemson. Here are kickoff times in Pacific and channels.
keyPoints: 9 a.m. PT: Alabama at Mississippi State (ABC) and Notre Dame at North Carolina (ESPN).
12:30 p.m. PT: Ohio State at Iowa on CBS and Paramount+.
4:30 p.m. PT: Washington at USC on NBC and Peacock, and Miami at Clemson on ABC.
6:30 p.m. PT: Fresno State at Washington State on USA Network.

sources.title: College football schedule: TV selections for October 3, 2026

body: Saturday is a full day of college football, and it overlaps with the start of baseball's Division Series. Here is the college slate in Pacific time so you can plan.
The morning starts at 9 a.m. with two big names on the road: Alabama at Mississippi State on ABC and Notre Dame at North Carolina on ESPN.
At 12:30 p.m., Ohio State visits Iowa on CBS, streaming on Paramount+. It is the main Big Ten game of the afternoon window.

The late afternoon is crowded. Oregon State plays at Colorado State at 3 p.m. on USA Network, and BYU plays at TCU at 4 p.m. on ESPN. At 4:30 p.m., Washington plays at USC on NBC and Peacock, while Miami visits Clemson on ABC and Utah State visits Boise State on CBS Sports Network. The night ends with Fresno State at Washington State at 6:30 p.m. on USA Network.

If your house splits between baseball and football, note that the Dodgers and Braves start at 1 p.m. Pacific, during the Ohio State-Iowa game, and the Padres and Brewers start at 5:30 p.m., during the USC game. Streaming one on a phone or tablet while the other is on TV can keep everyone happy.
Check your local listings Saturday morning, since networks sometimes move games between channels.
